<DOCSTRING>
Summary: Represents a user profile and provides methods to interact with it.

Description: The User class is created to store and validate user information. It is instantiated whenever a new user needs to be created in the system. The class is used by various services to handle user data and determine if a user is an adult.

Attributes:
    name (str): The user's name, set during initialization and used throughout the class.
    age (int): The user's age, set during initialization and used to determine if the user is an adult.
